name: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Sammaan Pension Yojana
benefit: **The following monthly pension will be provided:** Age CriteriaAmount75 Years or Less₹1,000/- per Month.75 Years or More₹1,250/- per Month.Leprosy Free Patient₹2,500/- per Month.Silicosis Disease Patient₹1,500/- per Month.
_eligibility_text:
1. Beneficiary must be permanent resident of Rajasthan State.
1. The beneficiary must have any one of the following disabilities:

  - 40% or more disability (blindness, shortsightedness, locomotor disability, leprosy free, hearing loss, mental retardation, mental illness, dwarfism, eunuch)
  - Dwarfism with height less than 3 feet 6 inches.
  - Suffering from Eunuchism.
  - Cured leprosy or Silicosis disease.

1. Annual family income must not exceed ₹60,000/-
